_comment: The weights this installation downloads for itself (scribe/models.py). Pinned by revision and verified by sha256 before anything loads them, the same rule tools.json states for binaries. Large files carry the Hub's own LFS digest, read from HfApi.model_info(files_metadata=True); small ones carry no LFS digest on the Hub and were hashed by hand. `backends` says which transcriber loads an entry (absent means every one of them), `tier` which quality setting asks for it, and `alias` the id the loader itself requests - kept here as data, so the model name stays spelled once in the package (ADR-004).
_pins: The four transcription entries were collected on 2026-09-22 (TASK-089.16). Revisions and every model.bin/weights digest: the Hub API, anonymously. config.json, preprocessor_config.json, tokenizer.json and vocabulary.json for the two CT2 repos: sha256 taken by hand from this machine's huggingface_hub cache, whose sizes the API confirmed byte for byte at the same revision. mlx-community/whisper-large-v3-mlx's config.json: sha256 taken by hand from a 269-byte GET of that revision. The mlx-community/whisper-large-v3-turbo entry is older and was not re-collected; the same method reproduces its revision and digest exactly, which is the cross-check that the two were built the same way.
